verdict.rationale: Linear documents initiatives as a level above projects, with lead teams, proposed and canceled statuses, and priority, and markets 'strategic roadmaps'. That implies a portfolio layer over multiple projects, and filtered project views can be shared and subscribed to. Explicit cross-project dashboards appear only through a third-party integration listing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that initiatives or roadmaps aggregate progress across projects, first-party portfolio dashboard or progress-rollup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
